comparison.objective: Separate loose media from washers, versus placing a tall canister behind a shelf fence under low clearance.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sifting versus tilt-to-insert, clearance management and upright placement of a tall rigid object.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media with no loss versus canister fully behind the fence and standing upright.
comparison.reason: Clearance-constrained placement does not test granular flow or aperture selectivity.
